name: Sachsenring
layout_source: https://www.sportpresseportal.de/media/pcLkQV/48330/download (DTM press release, keyfacts Sachsenring, rounds 13-14 2026: 3.645 Meter, 14 Kurven)

select.only_ways_note: Pinned to the ways of the verified lap so the drawing regenerates identically.

verify.notes: Official reference: motogp.com circuit SVG. Its track is styled with CSS classes that PyMuPDF ignores, so the stroked track paths (classes st1/st2: lap and pit lane) were copied with inline black strokes into a plain SVG and rasterised (scratch motogp_svg.py). Cars and bikes use the same lap; the DTM keyfacts (14 corners, anticlockwise) match it.

notes: Lap = closed loop of the raceway ways closest to the official length.
